title: Can I SURVIVE Racing Kings?
summary: Standard Racing Kings (chess.com variant) vs higher/equal-rated humans (~1590-1760); goal 3 wins. He wins game 1 (black), loses game 2, wins game 3 vs ~1760 and game 4 vs an equal-rated player for 3 wins.
rules: Racing Kings: no pawns; both sides start on ranks 1-2 (white pieces on the right half, black on the left half), kings race to the 8th rank.
Giving check is illegal: you may not make any move that puts the opponent's king in check (so captures that would give check are illegal).
First king to reach the 8th rank wins; if white's king reaches it first, black can draw by also reaching the 8th rank on the very next move.
Other piece moves normal; no castling.
win_condition: Get your king to the 8th rank first (black gets one reply move to draw).

opponent.name: Online humans (e.g. medleypaper 1763)
opponent.avatar_description: Default chess.com avatars; chat panel visible.

current_impl_issues: Base mode correct in concept; ensure the 'black may equalise on the next move' draw rule and 'cannot give check' legality are implemented.
evidence: Transcript 0:01 'kings race to the end of the board and checks are not allowed... first to the eighth rank... win three games'; 'You're not allowed to put your opponent's king in check'; game 4 'should the white king reach the end first, black can draw the game by reaching there right after'. Frames (visual_d): racing kings array on ranks 1-2, medleypaper (1763).
